excerpt: Heavy ion collisions quickly form a droplet of quark-gluon plasma (QGP) with a remarkably small viscosity ... These gluons quickly thermalize and form QGP, while the energetic partons traverse this plasma and end in a shower of particles called jets.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); W. Busza, K. Rajagopal, W. van der Schee
title: Heavy Ion Collisions: The Big Picture, and the Big Questions
